observations.why: The verb 'adopting' frames a new tool as a chosen forward step — novelty embraced as the appealed-to good.
The quantified speed gain appeals to mastery and capability — doing the work better, as the performed good.
Deferring the migration to a scheduled future quarter tempers the novelty with a measured, stability-preserving cadence.
The summary label restates the adoption of a new system as the headline value move.
The performance summary foregrounds a measurable capability gain as the good delivered.
Anchoring the change to a specific quarter schedules disruption into a controlled, stability-oriented frame.
